<thought>We need to determine the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule. The available tools include carbon_nmr_spectra, which can provide the 13C NMR data for the sample. By examining the chemical shift values, we can count the signals that fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). This will give us the aromatic carbon count without needing the explicit structure.</thought>
